# Extend the Copilot Toolkit

Ask what user wants. Match to type:

| Type | What it is |
|---|---|
| **Instructions** | Auto-applied rules by file pattern — coding standards, project behaviour |
| **Skills** | SKILL.md folder with optional assets — specialised on-demand tasks |
| **Agents** | Specialised Copilot agents with MCP integration |
| **Plugins** | Bundled agents+skills — install via VS Code or Copilot CLI |
| **Hooks** | Triggered actions during agent sessions (start, end, tool use) |
| **Agentic Workflows** | GitHub Actions automations written in markdown |
| **Cookbook** | Copy-paste recipes for Copilot tasks |

Search https://awesome-copilot.github.com. Show top matches with brief reason.
